Some changes announce themselves quickly. Others ask for a little more time — the kind of time it takes for a formula to become part of your daily rhythm, and for your body to respond.

BALANCE10 is Shala’s comprehensive hormone-balance formula, created for ten of the most common midlife concerns: night sweats and hot flashes, slow metabolism, emotional stability, mental clarity, physical exhaustion, low libido, vaginal dryness, dry and itchy skin, menstrual cycles, and poor sleep.

We hear from women after a few weeks. We also hear from them again around the 90-day mark. That is often when the story stops being “I think this is helping” and becomes “this is who I am now.”

What a 90-day clinical study found

In a 90-day clinical study of women aged 40 and above who used BALANCE10:

91.2% had fewer hot flashes
89.4% could cope with stress better
82.3% feeling more emotionally stable

Results may vary based on individual use. What this study makes clear is that consistent daily use over 90 days is the window where many women notice meaningful change — fewer heat spikes, and a greater capacity to meet stress without being undone by it.

What women are telling us

“BALANCE10 hands down is my favorite product. Health issues forced me into menopause and it wasn’t fun! It has leveled out my hormones and made me a person that I want to be around again.”
— Terry Halemba

“BALANCE10 keeps me feeling emotionally stable, really reduced my hot flashes and joint discomfort. I feel like a new woman when I take these supplements.”

That pairing; fewer heat spikes and a calmer inner weather; is what so many of you describe. Not a dramatic overnight reset. A gradual return of evenness: mood that holds, flashes that lose their edge, joints that feel less loud, skin and tissues that feel more supported from the inside.
